newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-STUTTGART LET ELBER GO TO BAYERN, SIGN AKPOBORIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STUTTGART LET ELBER GO TO BAYERN, SIGN AKPOBORIE.

text.p: VfB Stuttgart said on Monday their Brazilian striker Giovane Elber would join Bayern Munich in the close season and Nigerian Jonathan Akpoborie would be his replacement.
Stuttgart president Gerhard Mayer-Vorfelder said the club would receive more than 10 million marks ($5.8 million) for Elber, who would take over Juergen Klinsmann's striking berth at Bayern.
The Germany captain has said he will leave Bayern at the end of the season but has not yet decided where he will go.
Akpoborie will join Stuttgart from relegation-threatened Hansa Rostok, although he recently signed a new contract with the club.
